records.question: Do orders delivered late receive lower review scores?
records.raw:
WITH order_avg AS (
  SELECT 
    o.order_id,
    CASE WHEN o.order_delivered_customer_date > o.order_estimated_delivery_date THEN 'late' ELSE 'on_time' END AS delivery_status,
    AVG(r.review_score) AS avg_score
  FROM orders o
  JOIN order_reviews r ON o.order_id = r.order_id
  WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'
    AND o.order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL
    AND o.order_estimated_delivery_date IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY o.order_id, delivery_status
)
SELECT 
  delivery_status,
  AVG(avg_score) AS avg_review_score
FROM order_avg
GROUP BY delivery_status;

records.question: What share of revenue comes from customers who ordered more than once?
records.raw:
WITH valid_orders AS (
  SELECT o.order_id, c.customer_unique_id
  FROM orders o
  JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
  WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
),
order_revenue AS (
  SELECT oi.order_id, SUM(oi.price) AS revenue
  FROM order_items oi
  JOIN valid_orders vo ON vo.order_id = oi.order_id
  GROUP BY oi.order_id
),
customer_order_counts AS (
  SELECT customer_unique_id, COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS num_orders
  FROM valid_orders
  GROUP BY customer_unique_id
),
repeat_customers AS (
  SELECT customer_unique_id
  FROM customer_order_counts
  WHERE num_orders > 1
),
total_revenue AS (
  SELECT SUM(revenue) AS total
  FROM order_revenue
),
repeat_revenue AS (
  SELECT SUM(orr.revenue) AS repeat_total
  FROM order_revenue orr
  JOIN valid_orders vo ON vo.order_id = orr.order_id
  JOIN repeat_customers rc ON rc.customer_unique_id = vo.customer_unique_id
)
SELECT repeat_total / total AS share
FROM repeat_revenue, total_revenue;

  JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
  GROUP BY o.order_id, c.customer_state
)

LIMIT 1;

)
